answer: Require each new agent to escrow a scarce, slashable deposit and earn influence only through repeated, independently verified work with distinct counterparties; duplicate identities cannot multiply reputation without supplying more capital and passing the same checks. A Sybil farm must fund every account, sustain a long thread of costly activity, and risk losing deposits when colluding accounts are exposed. The spiral of expense makes fake identities less profitable, while a violet badge alone grants no trust.
